Know the timeline before the project starts

Foresprint is AI project estimation for IT and software services firms. It finds the past projects most like the new one and builds the team, timeline, budget, risks and full project plan from how those projects actually ran. Once work starts, it forecasts the finish whenever it is asked.
Live today on the AIQoD platform.

Most project estimates start from memory, not from past projects.

A new deal needs a team, a timeline and a price within days. The estimate is built in a spreadsheet by whoever is free, based on what they remember. Records of how similar projects actually ran sit in old files nobody opens. The gaps show up months later, once the work is underway.
Estimates depend on who writes them
Two people pricing the same project come back with two different numbers, and neither can show where theirs came from.
Effort is underestimated to win the deal
Roles, risks and rework get left out of the first estimate. The project is signed at a price it cannot be delivered for.
Slipping dates and rising cost show up in the monthly review or the finance report, when there is little room left to correct them.

AI project estimation uses data from past projects to work out the team, timeline, budget and risks for a new one. Foresprint is an agentic project estimation and forecasting solution built on the AIQoD platform. It finds the past projects closest to the new one and builds the estimate from how they actually ran. People review and approve every estimate.
Is Foresprint a project management tool?
No. Foresprint does not run or manage projects. It plans, estimates and forecasts, for new projects and for projects already running. Your project management tools keep doing the day-to-day tracking.
Does Foresprint work with our existing project tools?
Yes. It works with the systems you already use and reads project data from them. Tasks, updates and tracking stay where they are. Nothing is replaced or migrated.
Where do the estimates come from?

From your own project history. Foresprint searches past projects for the closest matches to the new one and shows each match with a percentage. The proposed team, risks, timeline and budget are each shown next to the past project they came from.
Can Foresprint be used on a project that is already running?
Yes. It works for new projects and existing ones. For a running project it compares actuals with the baseline and forecasts the finish.
How does project forecasting work in Foresprint?

Forecasts are on demand. When a forecast is requested, Foresprint fetches the latest data from your project systems and checks it against how similar past projects finished. It returns the estimate at completion, cost overrun and risk alerts, and resource utilization suggestions.
Does Foresprint calculate estimate at completion (EAC)?
Yes. Every forecast includes the estimate at completion, based on current progress and the performance of similar past projects.
Can Foresprint help with fixed price project estimation?
Yes. Pre-sales and bid teams use it to estimate proposals from real delivery history, with risks listed before the price is fixed and a clear source behind every number in the quote.
Can the team change what Foresprint suggests?
Yes. The proposed team, risk register, timeline and budget can all be edited before the project plan is generated. People make the final call.
What happens when the project start date changes?
Every task and milestone date in the plan is recalculated. The plan does not need to be rebuilt.
Does Foresprint warn about cost overruns?
Yes. Each forecast flags where cost is heading over budget and which risks are rising, along with suggestions on how people across the project are being used.
How long does it take to go live?
The first configuration goes live in a day, with measurable results typically inside three to six weeks.
